The story is about names gently vanishing; show fading ink marks as abstract marks, no readable text. Palette: deep indigo, faded ivory, vermilion, warm muted gold; not glossy neon. Beautiful refined mysterious evening, not horror. No characters, no logos, no text, no UI, no border, no watermark. Render a finished painted background, not a mockup. Opaque background.
